newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-WAIKATO CHIEFS BEAT QUEENSLAND IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WAIKATO CHIEFS BEAT QUEENSLAND IN SUPER 12.

text.p: The Waikato Chiefs got their Super 12 campaign on track when they beat the Queensland Reds 31-16 at Rugby Park on Saturday.
The Chiefs produced a solid all-round performance to outscore the Reds by three tries to one.
The Chiefs led 23-10 at half time with tries by wingers Dion Matthews and Bruce Reihana.
Queensland flying left-winger Ben Tune crossed over in the 30th minute.
In the second half, Queensland raised their intensity level but were rewarded by only two penalties.
Matt Cooper crossed over for the Chiefs and kicked a penalty for a personal tally of 23 points in the game.
Queensland now take on Auckland at Eden Park on Easter Monday.
Saturday's win gave the Waikato Chiefs three victories from four matches.
